title: DJ Pequeña Cretina aka Alexandra Martinez
bio: Pequeña Cretina aka Alexandra Martinez has been deejaying for decades. She is the award winning author of two poetry collections and runs Galaxy Pies, a small batch bakeshop located in Joshua Tree, CA.
socials: IG: alxndramartinez, Book Reviews and More: alexandramartinez.substack.com
showDescription: Pequeña Cretina is an ever-evolving experiment in sound centered around music but also interviews with authors and artists. Sometimes there's poetry readings, sometimes there's advice, sometimes there's just people screaming, tune in.
